sloka: असङ्ख्या सुमहत्यासीत्तस्य सेना महात्मनः ।शूराणामग्रयातऽणां सहस्राणि शतानि च ।। ७.२१.२९ ॥
transliteration: asaṅkhyā sumahatyāsīttasya senā mahātmanaḥ ।śūrāṇāmagrayāta'ṇāṁ sahasrāṇi śatāni ca ।। 7.21.29 ॥

translations.english: The army of that great-souled Yama was immeasurably vast, comprising hundreds and thousands of brave warriors leading the charge.
